newsitem.title: JAPAN: IBJ falls on Japan bank sector concerns.
newsitem.headline: IBJ falls on Japan bank sector concerns.

text.p: Shares of the Industrial Bank of Japan lost ground in Friday afternoon trade, dragged down by persisting worries about the banking sector, brokers said.
At 0351 GMT the shares were down 20 yen at 1,600.
"The problem of bad loans the bank sector is saddled with has yet to be solved and that is making foreign investors especially opt for short-positions," a trader at a "big four" brokerage said.
Other banks were also lower. Fuji Bank Ltd was down 40 yen at 1,300, in trade of 3.499 million shares. It was the fourth most heavily traded issue on the first section of the exchange.
Sumitomo Bank Ltd was down 20 yen at 1,350.
